dataset: An Open Combinatorial Diffraction Dataset Including Consensus Human and Machine Learning Labels with Quantified Uncertainty
canonicalExtraction: human-labels.json is a values-only extraction of the public Human Labels.xlsx workbook. The original workbook and 13.4 MB raw profile file are not republished; their official URLs, byte-level hashes, and derived audits are retained.

correction.finding: The previous humanLabelsSha256 value belongs to the composition-temperature text file, not Human Labels.xlsx. The workbook hash was independently downloaded and reconciled with the official NIST metadata API.
